confidence_notes: I ran three web searches: one for the RBA rate and two for Tainan prices. The searches returned aggregated crowd-sourced and estimate-based pages (MyLifeElsewhere, TravelTables, and Numbeo figures quoted by Nomad Watch). I did not open the underlying pages. Beer, coffee, inexpensive meal and mid-range meal anchors are loosely supported by those figures. The sources disagree and some are dated, so I set the inexpensive meal between the NT$120 Numbeo-derived figure and the higher MyLifeElsewhere figure, which includes a drink. The mid-range meal anchor is based on a TravelTables figure of about $26.80, nudged up for inflation. The searches returned no cocktail or wine-by-the-glass prices, so those two are my estimates from the local price relationship to beer, with cocktails at roughly 2.3x beer and wine at roughly 2x. I did not search for accommodation. All four accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Taiwanese mid-sized tourist cities, and they are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tainan is a mid-sized Taiwanese tourism city. Its prices are typically somewhat below Taipei for food and accommodation. It is comparable to Taichung and Kaohsiung, and its accommodation is cheaper than that of major Japanese cities.
